gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: As a customer, I want to browse available mobile devices, review product details and default configurations, view promotional offers and estimated delivery information, authenticate when required, and seamlessly continue my purchase journey after successful login, so that I can make an informed purchase decision and complete my mobile device purchase successfully.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: When the Product Details Page is opened, the application shall: Display the default device colour. Display the default storage option. Display the default payment option. Display the correct pricing for the default configuration. Display the estimated delivery date. Display the promotional offer (if available).
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify default device configuration displays correct values for Colour, Storage, and Payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page
Verify default device configuration displays correct colour, storage, and payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Test cases 658 and 668 validate default colour (Black/Awesome Navy), storage (256GB), and payment option (24-month installment). However, they do not explicitly verify correct pricing for default configuration, estimated delivery date, or promotional offer display. These three critical aspects are missing from test coverage, representing a significant gap in validating the complete Product Details Page default configuration display requirements.
recommended_test_enhancements: Add explicit verification step to validate correct pricing calculation and display based on default configuration (colour, storage, payment option)
Add verification step to confirm estimated delivery date is displayed and formatted correctly on the Product Details Page
Add verification step to validate promotional offer is displayed when available and appropriately hidden when not applicable
Create dedicated test case to verify pricing accuracy across different device configurations
Implement test case to validate delivery date calculation logic and display format consistency

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: The customer shall be able to: View the Next button. Click the Next button. Continue to the next purchase step. Prevent duplicate submissions when the button is clicked multiple times. Resume the purchase journey after successful authentication.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify Next button is interactable and initiates the next step in purchase journey
Verify Next button initiates the next step in purchase journey
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Test cases 659 and 669 validate Next button visibility, clickability, and initiation of next purchase step. Test cases 664 and 674 validate duplicate submission prevention. However, none of the test cases explicitly verify resuming the purchase journey after successful authentication, which is a critical aspect of the user experience. This gap means the end-to-end authentication flow and context preservation after login is not validated.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create end-to-end test case that validates complete authentication flow: user clicks Next on PDP, login popup appears, user successfully logs in, system redirects user back to exact purchase step with selected configuration intact
Add verification to confirm user can continue purchase journey seamlessly after authentication without re-selecting device or configuration
Implement test case to validate session state preservation across authentication boundary
Add test steps to verify purchase context (device selection, configuration options) is maintained after login
Create negative test case to verify purchase journey cannot proceed if authentication is cancelled or fails

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: If the customer is not authenticated, the application shall: Display the Login popup after clicking Next. Display Login and Sign Up options. Prevent the purchase journey until authentication is completed. Redirect the customer back to the interrupted purchase step after successful login.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify login or sign-up popup is displayed with correct message and action buttons when unauthenticated user clicks Next
Verify login and sign-up popup displays with correct message and action buttons for unauthenticated user
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Test cases 660 and 670 validate login popup display, message content, and Login/Sign Up button visibility for unauthenticated users. However, they do not verify that the purchase journey is prevented until authentication is completed, nor do they validate redirection back to the interrupted purchase step after successful login. This represents a critical gap in validating the authentication gate and post-authentication user experience.
recommended_test_enhancements: Add verification step to confirm purchase journey is blocked until user completes authentication (verify no bypass is possible)
Implement test case to validate that after successful login, user is redirected to the interrupted purchase step with context preserved (device selection, configuration)
Add test steps to verify user can seamlessly continue from where they left off after authentication
Create test case to validate popup cannot be dismissed without completing authentication or explicitly cancelling
Add verification to confirm device configuration and user selections are preserved across authentication flow
Implement test case to verify appropriate error handling if authentication fails or is cancelled

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: The application shall gracefully handle error scenarios including: Network interruption while loading pages. Device unavailability or out-of-stock condition. Slow network response while loading the Product Details Page. HTTP 500/Internal Server Error. API timeout while retrieving product details. Display appropriate error messages without crashing.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify system behavior when user attempts to navigate to All Phones with network interruption
Verify system behavior when All Phones listing page fails to load or displays zero items
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Test cases 661 and 671 validate network interruption handling and page load failures. Test case 662 validates device unavailability/out-of-stock scenarios. Test case 672 validates error handling for unavailable devices. Test case 663 validates slow network response. However, explicit test cases for HTTP 500/Internal Server Error and API timeout scenarios are not present. The coverage is partial as not all critical error scenarios are explicitly tested, leaving potential gaps in error handling validation.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create dedicated test case to verify HTTP 500/Internal Server Error handling when loading PDP or device listing - verify appropriate error message is displayed and application does not crash
Implement test case for API timeout scenario when retrieving product details - verify timeout handling, error message display, and retry mechanism if available
Add verification to confirm all error messages are user-friendly and provide actionable guidance
Create test case to validate error recovery mechanisms and user ability to retry failed operations
Implement test case to verify application stability and graceful degradation under multiple concurrent error conditions
Add test steps to validate error logging and monitoring for production support

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: The customer shall be able to: Navigate from the StarHub Home page to Mobile → All Phones. View the Mobile Devices listing page. Verify the page heading is displayed correctly. Verify the correct URL is loaded. View all available mobile devices.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can successfully navigate to Mobile Devices listing page from StarHub personal homepage
Verify successful navigation to All Phones listing page from StarHub homepage

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: The customer shall be able to: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing. Navigate to the Product Details Page. Verify the product information. Verify the Product Details Page URL.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing and navigate to device details page
Verify Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device details page displays when selected from All Phones listing

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: The application shall ensure that the authentication popup: Displays correctly on Desktop. Displays correctly on Tablet. Displays correctly on Mobile. Maintains usability across supported screen resolutions.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
